content: {"paper_id":"lab-effcb20ed6d4","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"partial-label-learning","exact_quote":"Partial Label Learning (PLL) trains models from instances with candidate label sets containing the ground-truth","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文以候选标签集包含真值的偏标记学习为核心任务，标准设定下仅一个候选标签为真。"},{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"Semi-Supervised Partial Label Learning (SSPLL) further leverages the available unlabeled data","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"明确结合未标注数据提升SSPLL性能，符合半监督学习设定。"},{"keyword_id":"class-imbalance","exact_quote":"performance collapse on minority classes","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"研究未知类别分布导致少数类性能崩溃及训练数据偏向多数类，显式处理类别不平衡。"},{"keyword_id":"pseudo-label-self-training","exact_quote":"via prior-aware pseudo-label admission","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"采用先验感知伪标签准入，把模型对未标注样本的预测作为后续训练信号并筛选。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"instances with candidate label sets containing the ground-truth","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"用候选标签集而非精确实例级标签监督模型，属不精确弱监督，并作为论文研究设定。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
